name: ZCA_FEED_DATALOAD_STATUS
description: Stores the status of Objects being loaded into Feed tables.

columns.name: FEED_DATALOAD_ID
columns.description: Auto generated primary key of the table.

columns.name: FEED_DATALOAD_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: The name of the object being loaded.

columns.name: FEED_DATALOAD_OBJECT_CRITERIA
columns.description: The criteria using which the object was loaded.

columns.name: FEED_DATALOAD_ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: The ESS request id of the process.

columns.name: FEED_DATALOAD_PARENT_ESS_ID
columns.description: The parent ESS request id which invoked this process.

columns.name: FEED_DATALOAD_UCM_ID
columns.description: UCM Id for the export file.

columns.name: FEED_DATALOAD_EXPORTED_RECORDS
columns.description: The number of records exported using BulkExport.

columns.name: FEED_DATALOAD_LOADED_RECORDS
columns.description: The number of records loaded using SQL Loader.

columns.name: FEED_DATALOAD_TYPE
columns.description: Whether it is a day zero job or incremental job.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
